title: Old appliance exchange - cashback on your new TV or fridge
body: Send a photo of your old appliance on WhatsApp and get an honest cashback quote in minutes. The value is deducted on your new purchase, with free pickup inside Kathmandu valley.

title: Easy EMI on selected appliances
body: Take home a new appliance today and pay in easy monthly installments. Exchange value is deducted first, then EMI can be arranged on the balance. Message us for your plan.

title: Serving Kathmandu for 20+ years
body: From our store at Samakhushi Chowk we have served homes and offices for over two decades - sales, service, exchange and repair. Trusted brands: Samsung, LG, Himstar, Skyworth, Whirlpool, Aura, Panasonic and more.

title: Second-hand clearance - tested units, big discounts
body: Checked and serviced second-hand TVs, fridges and washing machines in stock at 40-60% below new MRP, with a 30-day service guarantee. Stock moves fast - ask for today's list on WhatsApp.

title: Free delivery + installation inside Kathmandu valley
body: Order any appliance and we deliver and install it for free inside the valley, with shipping across Nepal. Payment: cash, bank, eSewa/Khalti or card. EMI on selected models.
